def check_distinct(t):
    """
    Check if a tuple contains no duplicate elements.
    
    Args:
        t (tuple): The input tuple
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if all elements are distinct, False otherwise
    """
    # Convert the tuple to a set; duplicates will be removed automatically
    return len(t) == len(set(t))

# Test cases
assert check_distinct((1, 4, 5, 6, 1, 4)) == False
print("Test passed: Tuple with duplicates returns False")

# Additional test case for clarity
assert check_distinct((1, 2, 3, 4)) == True
print("Test passed: Tuple without duplicates returns True")
